h1: A Drupal audit that tells you what to fix first
overview: We review your Drupal site from the point of view of a visitor, an editor and a developer. We check the version and update status, installed modules, security settings, speed, mobile display, search basics and how easy it is for your team to publish. You get a written report with each finding ranked by importance and effort, with screenshots and plain steps, and an optional call to talk it through.

faq: Do you fix the problems you find?
The audit is a report, not a repair. You can use it with your own developer, or order one of our fix packages for the items you choose.
A staging copy or read only admin access is enough for most checks. We never change anything during an audit, and we never ask for your password.
Can you audit an old Drupal 7 site?
Yes. We include the end of support status and a plain upgrade path in the report, so you know your options and how much work each involves.
Do you check security in depth?
We check settings, roles, update status and known risky modules. A full penetration test is a specialist job and is outside this audit. We say so clearly in the report.
